_why: What scripts/sheetcheck.py lets a .sheet, .fullScreenCover or <dialog> present besides the one sheet (Kit/BrandSheet.swift, components/Sheet.astro). Every name carries its reason; a new overlay becomes the one sheet or earns a line here. Hidde, 2026-10-10.

app.AmbassadorApplySheet: two BrandSheet steps, the explainer and the receipt
app.PermissionRecovery: a BrandSheet, wrapped so three call sites share the words
app.collectChoice: the tree page's collect sheet, three BrandSheet states
app.SignInSheet: the reference the one sheet is measured from (CONVENTIONS.md, the sign-in sheet); same handle, cross, tile and button sizes, provider buttons in the providers' own colours
app.CollectSheet: the camera flow: its first screen uses the sheet's buttons, every later step is a map, a list or a form at full height
app.LibraryPicker: the system photo picker, full screen
app.PhotoViewer: a photograph at full size, full screen
app.PlacePin: a map to drag a pin on, full screen
app.ProfileEditor: a form: your name and picture
app.ContributeView: a form: a tree, a correction or feedback
app.SpeciesChooser: a list to pick a species from
app.SpeciesPicker: a list to pick a species from
app.editor: a one-field form on your own tree (FieldEditor)
app.accountSheet: a page: your account and deleting it, with a field to type DELETE
app.legalSheet: a page of map and photo credits

web.signin-dialog: the reference the one sheet is measured from (SignInModal.astro), and AppModal.astro which shares its frame
web.photo-view: a photograph at full size, full screen (PhotoFigure.astro)
web.pin-dlg: a map to drag a pin on, full screen (TreeDetail.astro)
